name: Terebyte
oneLine: Give an AI a room in your encrypted Terebyte vault: it sees that room and nothing else.
description: Terebyte is end-to-end encrypted cloud storage. This MCP server lets an assistant or an agent work in one room a member opens to it: list, read and write files, make a Sealed Link, and use the room's board. The member pairs it with a 6-character code and chooses what it may do and for how long. Everything is encrypted and decrypted on the computer it runs on; Terebyte's servers see only sealed bytes.
